title: Clear the Way With Check
setup: Your bishop on e8 and queen on c8 are stacked on the back rank, and Black's rooks on c6 and e5 hold it together.
hint: Your own piece is standing on the mating square. Find the move that removes it and gains a tempo at the same time.
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop on e8 is in the queen's way. {{Bxc6+}} takes a rook, vacates the square and gives check all at once; {{Re8}} is forced and {{Qxe8#}} ends it. The best in-between move is the one that does three jobs.
